name: iletimerkezi-iletimerkezi-mcp-server
description: Send SMS, query delivery reports, manage senders / blacklists, register and check İYS (Turkish messaging consent registry) records through the [iletiMerkezi](https://www.iletimerkezi.com) BTK-licensed SMS API. 11 tools, runtime-fetched manifest stays in lock-step with the live API. Install: `npx -y @iletimerkezi/mcp-server`.
